test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.

Don't try to walk _______ (after) you can crawl.
solution:
The correct answer is **'before'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'After' **generally refers to following in time or place. **('बाद में').**

 
 
• **Example: **We will have lunch 'after' the meeting.
 
 
 
• The correct word to fill in the blank as an antonym of** 'after'** is** 'before'.**
 
• **'Before'** refers to at an earlier time.** ('पहले').**
 
 
• **Example:** You need to read 'before' you can write. 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Already' **means prior to a specified or implied time or as soon as.** ('पहले से').**
 
• **'Later'** refers to at some time in the future.** ('बाद में').**
 
• **'Soon' **means in a short time. **('जल्दी').**

1d7:T6ac,

The correct answer is: &
